title: Configuration
description: What a server returns for a signed GET of /.well-known/qory-configuration, per access key: the access key's node, where Forager posts its events, where a run registers, whether the access key is allowed stored secrets, and the server's keys. A section Forager does not recognise is ignored; an added section is a new revision of this contract.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

node_id.description: The id of the access key's node, nd_, or node pool, np_, followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters. Listed for every verified access key, for display.

events.description: Where the events go and which.

url.description: The endpoint every batch is posted to. https, or http to a loopback address only.

types.description: The event types the server wants, by full type name, or * for every type.

run.description: The run endpoint, which every server has. A run registers with a signed POST to url, whose body is a run-registration.schema.json document and whose answer is the run's run configuration; a reload fetches the run configuration again with a signed GET of url followed by a slash and the run's id. A document without run is refused.

url.description: The run endpoint. https, or http to a loopback address only, with no query and no fragment: a reload appends a slash and the run's id to it.

secrets.description: Present for an access key allowed stored secrets. A server that lists it requires a wall for every run against it.

url.description: https, or http to a loopback address only.

apiary_public_key.description: The server's Ed25519 public keys, the current one and during a rotation the next one after it, listed for every verified access key for information: Forager verifies under its pin alone.
